answer: Each identity appoints one summit courier and locks a 70-credit bond. The courier carries a key-sealed whisper to the summit beacon, which logs key, hash, and arrival. The auditor checks the log: one courier carries only one whisper per epoch, so the kth fake still needs a new courier at 150 credits plus 70, 220 each. A rented-courier ring fails because a courier key reused for two whispers burns both bonds, and a replayed whisper fails the beacon nonce. One thousand fakes pay 150,000 plus 70,000 locked. An honest identity pays 150 once and recovers its bond on exit.
